info.title: API.SH: zooplus
info.description: The zooplus API from API.SH: public zooplus data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The zooplus category tree of a country shop (cats, dogs, small pets, fish, birds, horses and their sub-categories down to brands): id, title, level, animal, path and link. A path works as `category` on /zooplus/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zooplus-categories

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (prices, language and range follow it). Default DE.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One zooplus product by link, path or id: title, brands, summary, full description, ingredients/composition, feeding recommendation, price range, average rating, review count and ratings by star, images, documents, breadcrumbs and every variant (size) with its EAN, price, reference price, unit price, subscription and first-order discounts, availability, seller, delivery days, nutrients (analytical constituents), attributes, description and images, plus `raw`. A bare id is looked up through the shop's search first.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zooplus-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A product link or its /shop/... path. Either url or id is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product id, e.g. 1983705.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (prices, language and range follow it). Default DE.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of a zooplus product in the shop's language: rating, date, title, text, the reviewer's first name and initials (`author`) and the name the shop shows (`author_name`), country, the variant reviewed, helpful votes, verified purchase flag, source and the topics the review mentions with their sentiment; page 1 also carries the rating summary (average, total and count by star). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zooplus-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id or product link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (prices, language and range follow it). Default DE.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page (default 20, max 50).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: zooplus product search and category listing
get.description:
Search zooplus products by keywords, or list a category, in any of its 21 country shops, with every filter the shop offers: each facet type in the answer's `filters` list is a param (brand, action=is_new/has_abd/price_reduced, rating, pet size, life phase, food type, flavour, special care, packaging size and more; comma list = any of), a price range and six sort orders. Each product: id, title, summary, price text, alternative price, reduced flag, discount and promotion text, rating, review count, number of variants, new/limited/sponsored flags, subscription eligibility, pet types, delivery days, images and links, plus `raw`; also the facets with their values and counts. 48 per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zooplus-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Either q or category is required.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path such as /shop/hunde/hundefutter_trockenfutter, or its link (brand pages are paths too).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (prices, language and range follow it). Default DE.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name(s) as the facet lists them, comma list.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: is_new, has_abd (extra discount), price_reduced, zooplus_selected (comma list).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating 1-5.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price, whole units of the shop's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price, whole units.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
